frequency_question: What proportion of scheduled central bank rate-setting meeting cycles within an 87-day calendar window feature at least one decision to raise the policy rate?
membership_rule: Includes any formal scheduled bimonthly or quarterly monetary policy committee meeting where a rate decision is voted upon and announced; excludes unscheduled emergency inter-meeting rate changes.
provenance_note: 7 cases named, 18 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.6x)
coverage_note: 7 named recent meetings fully audited; 11 projected through end of 2026 based on statutory bimonthly schedule.
known_gaps: Future scheduled meetings late 2026 assume standard calendar adherence without unscheduled emergency sessions.
skeleton: RBI bi-monthly scheduled meetings per year (6) multiplied by the active hiking cycle rate over the 3-year observation window.
multiplier: 6 meetings per year over 3 years equals 18 total scheduled windows, of which 0 resulted in a rate hike under current prevailing easing/neutral conditions.
validity_reason: The statutory bimonthly meeting schedule is fixed by law through the end of the target window.
